why: v5 flickers on 01V and 03V on both routes; neither was among its four check shots. Cause (analytic 01V, replayed): the finish crossfades the master into the fill by the source's code, and on a still shot the codec moves a code near the clip by 1-2 codes from frame to frame; at code 251 that moves the mix by up to 0.12 and, with the analytic master about 1.7 stops under the fill's level, the pixel by up to 0.2 stops (98 % of the worst changes within 4 px of a clipped edge). 03V adds the inside of thin clipped shapes, which v5 redraws a little differently every frame. On the learned route the learned master rebuilds a clipped area itself, brighter than the fill's level and unsteady near the clip (master alone: Porch L 7.83 x white, T 0.749 EV; water L 23.96, T 0.671; 01V T 0.275), so its share of the crossfade comes through as flicker and as a rim brighter than the core (Porch L 4.07), and a newly clipped pixel shows it for one frame before the mask takes it (03V's jumps).
